name: release_check
title: Check release readiness
description: Run the pre-release checks; for an nx repository only the alerts are checked

version.description: Release version (detected from the CHANGELOG when omitted)

package.description: Package name in a monorepo (required for repositories with packages configured)

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

version.description: Version to release (omitted when release_type is nx, where only the alerts are checked)

tag.description: Tag to create (omitted when release_type is nx)

releaseNotes.description: Release notes from the CHANGELOG (omitted when release_type is nx)

commitCount.description: Number of commits from the release branch to the develop branch (omitted when release_type is nx)

skipped.description: Checks skipped because the feature is disabled, as in the skipped lines (e.g. "Dependabot alerts (feature disabled)")

dependabotAlerts.description: Dependabot alert status (omitted when it could not be read; the release is not blocked)

openCount.description: Number of open alerts (0 when disabled)

maxSeverity.description: Highest severity of the open alerts (omitted when there is none)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
